rule: Research narrows and explains a design choice. It does not pretend that a color, shape, typeface, or animation guarantees conversion.

decisions.decision: Position FAMtastic as an owned branded layer that can integrate with the current marketplace or scheduler instead of claiming to replace its complete operating stack.
Keep one portable booking slot whose binding may be an external link, widget, owner-controlled calendar, or request-to-book. Provider activation remains a reviewed setup choice.
Booking is additive. Domain, forwarding email, contact, services, policies, work, hours, location, and accessible navigation remain the starter foundation.
Use curves and overlapping planes for care and consultation stories, then anchor them with familiar grids so expressiveness does not become confusion.
Use angular calibration marks for precision as a brand metaphor, but soften the primary booking action and preserve familiar navigation and card structure.
Use poster modules and diagonal signals for energy while holding copy to a disciplined grid and equal bilingual hierarchy.
Pair oversized compressed display text with tabular service facts and bounded paragraph widths; expressive type owns headlines, not long reading.
Use editorial serif contrast for emotional phrases and sans-serif for actions, facts, and form labels so the reading task stays clear.
Give both languages the same typographic status; language order is an owner-controlled field rather than an ethnicity-derived template assumption.
Place one primary booking action in the opening scan path, then repeat it only after services and booking choices answer the user's decision questions.
Use motion as a brief reveal or material cue, never as the only carrier of content; honor reduced motion and avoid unpausable essential movement.
Limit poster movement to short controlled transitions that stop on interaction and disappear under reduced motion.
The premium parent image establishes environment and craft; three reference-led candidates test process, detail, and owner-operating moments without changing the recipe.
Use texture and consultation imagery rather than generic glamour; each candidate keeps the parent's material and lighting canon.
Use a consistent shop world across four image slots and let native HTML carry every bilingual word.
Use one luminous premium parent and three maintenance/consultation candidates; generated media never contains final prices, controls, or claims.
